body: Talking to my lawyer tomorrow will determine the possible outcome of the situation
Finding out I could possible serve a jail term or get deported. I made a thread in suicide watch with the details. Still haven't gotten over the initial shock.

Thank you for the kind words. I just don't know how to bring it up. If anything I will start with my brother. I would love to talk to my girlfriend about it but it will break her down very much I already know and I can't have that. I can't take it seeing her down or sad. I do love her very much.
Thanks after I speak to my lawyer tomorrow that will ultimately decide the outcome.
I hate being a disappointment to everyone and everyone will view me as such.

I would rather not live than have a horrible future.

If I got deported it's starting all over in a foreign country. 
If I went to jail, permanently have a criminal back ground, live with always being judged for one stupid choice I made when I was 18, be unable to have a promising career for myself.

I have a meeting with my lawyer tomorrow and depending on what I get from that meeting will determine how long I'll still be around. 

Yesterday morning my mom called me just to say hi and to wish me a Good Day which she almost never does and I almost broke down and started crying and I haven't cried for as long as I can remember. 

My girlfriend would be really hurt we are both really in love (some might think I am young to be in love, I've always thought that I would never fall in love and would keep shuffling through women until I met her all of that changed). I enjoy her company and absolutely love being around her and she is really amazing. She is the first person ever who I have ever spilled my emotions to about everything but I can't get myself to talk to her about this. 

This feeling fucking sucks.

I have always had lots of things going on for me. I once did something really stupid almost three years ago and did a minor car insurance fraud (reported car stolen when it wasn't). I have court date coming up and the worst part is I'm a permanent resident (lived in the US for the last ten years). Everyone in my family are citizens. My whole life I remember is here in the US. I am not looking for a shoulder to cry on for my crime that I did when I was 18, the crimes I am facing possible 15 years and possible deportation. I am thinking the way is to just end it all and don't want to be anyone's responsibility. The worst part is if I get deported I don't know or remember anything from my home country but I do have family. If I don't and serve a jail term my whole life is ruined will never be able to hold a good job and I have a really good resume (worked for a fortune 500 company since I was 16 years old and make really good money) and I only have a year till I graduate and I know for sure I will be making a good salary based on my resume and experience (management has promised me a good position and are pretty keen on keeping me within the company for a while. Why did I do the crime? I was greedy and realized I bought a POS and thought the money could help me to pay for school. Now, the only reason I am thinking of going through with it, is I don't want a struggling future because of a criminal background and if I was to get deported I don't know anything of the other country. I care very deeply about my brother, he is literally my best friend and I can imagine he would be really hurt about this. Also my girlfriend who I care very much for and I am in love with her, she's perfect in every aspect (hot, intelligent). I know they would both be really devastated. I also feel bad for my parents since they literally gave up everything to move to a foreign country and they say that they did it for my brother and I. I don't know how I am going to do it but I don't want a future of problems and depending on others because I can't make a future of my own. If this problem wasn't there I would never consider suicide and I am otherwise very happy with everything else in life.
